title: Line Integral Along a Piecewise Smooth Path
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Evaluate int_C (2x + y) ds where C consists of C_1 from (0, 0) to (1, 0) followed by C_2 from (1, 0) to (1, 2).

steps.title: Evaluate Integral on Segment C_1
steps.mathExpression: C_1: y = 0, \; 0 \le x \le 1, \; ds = dx \implies \int_{C_1} (2x + 0) \, dx = \left[ x^2 \right]_0^1 = 1

steps.title: Evaluate Integral on Segment C_2
steps.mathExpression: C_2: x = 1, \; 0 \le y \le 2, \; ds = dy \implies \int_{C_2} (2(1) + y) \, dy = \left[ 2y + \frac{y^2}{2} \right]_0^2 = 4 + 2 = 6
